title: The best in the business
body: Tick tick is the best in the business. The simplicity, aesthetics are my favourites. The development and product management team are well updated when it comes to bringing new stuff to the app. When the OS releases brings new features , ticktick is the first one to adopt it. A goal based progress tracking is the only thing I felt missing in this app. I am a premium user and it’s well worth it. Subscription price is also optimal. I hope they don’t duck it up and see the user churn.

author: Viking525

title: Good but got potential
body: New review 2023 I’ll stand by my last review that design have a lot to work with in this app. Lack of translation of UI and smart text makes it horrible to make new tasks using speech in my native language, having to mix two languages. Better integration of Apple tasks and calendar would be great so that I don’t have to use CalDAV link in Fantastical. That said I did cancel and resubscribe because this app have a huge feature set that I like/need, a set of functions that other apps can’t match. Would be a 5/5 if all above is fixed, even excluding UI design improvement. Family sharing needs to be enabled, many other apps have this. I'm looking for alternatives to this app pr December 2023.

title: The tool I have been searching for for 15 years
body:
This people understand task management! I have been looking for something so simple as being able to drop my to-dos on a calendar to plan my work and studies. Tick tick does this and then some. Love the kanban board and pomodoro timer!

If I could suggest one change, it would be making it easier to tick off to-dos from the calendar view. Otherwise, it’s perfect!

title: A very, very good app. Love it.
body: I have tried/used many «to do» apps, this is the best so far. I use TickTick on Mac and Iphone/Ipad and will continue with that. Just left Wunderlist when I heard that it was fading out and will end in near future. The price is not bad considering that annually payment include both Mac and ios. Among other apps that I have used and cancelled is Todoist. It was good, but TickTick is better in my opinion. ( I use TickTick for work and private)
